field.label: Enable
field.help: Allow tun/tap tunnels over the system SSH service (System: Settings: Administration). Port and listen interfaces are taken from there.

field.label: Permit root VPN logins
field.help: NetworkManager-ssh logs in as root. If "Permit root user login" is disabled in the system SSH settings, this re-allows root logins for keys with a forced command only (PermitRootLogin forced-commands-only), i.e. the VPN client keys. Has no effect when root login is already permitted.
